show.description: Shanaya walked away from Dhruv, the man who truly loved her, and chose an abusive husband hiding another marriage. What she thought was a winning choice soon turned into regret, while the man she abandoned rose to become a billionaire, finding love and happiness again. One Last Chance is a gripping story of betrayal, regret, and the price of choices.
